summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software engineer, computer science background, strong interest in programming languages (especially Lisp and Scheme), avid user of Linux (Gentoo), enjoys reading philosophy and literature, critical of mainstream media and societal norms, values privacy, prefers solitude, has a tendency towards social withdrawal, engages in discussions about ethics and political issues, interested in technology and its implications, has a nuanced view on mental health and euthanasia, skeptical of corporate and government practices, enjoys discussing historical and philosophical topics, has a critical view of contemporary education and its focus on STEM over the humanities.
